description: This file contains a Python implementation of a system executive class for managing subprocesses, process control, and error handling, including classes for script errors and process management utilities.

classes.name: ScriptError
classes.description: Custom exception class for script execution errors, capturing message, script arguments, exit code, output, and working directory.

classes.name: Executive
classes.description: Class providing methods for process management, executing commands, killing processes, checking process status, and handling subprocess I/O.

methods.name: kill_process
methods.description: Attempts to kill a process by PID, handling platform-specific differences.

methods.name: check_running_pid
methods.description: Checks if a process with given PID is currently running.

methods.name: run_command
methods.description: Runs a command with arguments, capturing output, handling timeouts, and errors.

methods.name: popen
methods.description: Creates a subprocess with specified arguments.

methods.name: map
methods.description: Runs multiple commands in parallel using multiprocessing pool.
